# WO-199: Refresh the developer configuration reference
Status: open (local scope prepared; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`; replaces CP-42/#170

## Goal
Make configuration options scannable and accessible while retaining the existing documented schema.

## Acceptance criteria
- Apply the reviewed scoped foundation and make field names, defaults, and explanations easy to compare.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed route content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Preserve the meaning and facts of all existing configuration documentation; do not change schema or application behavior.
- Keep table headings and row headings semantically associated in built output.
- Add a focused built-output regression test for table semantics and documented fields.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% display scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit every claim against D8; flag any claim outside the allowed list.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/developers/config/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_config_table_semantics.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No config schema, app code, CLI route, shared tokens, global styles, CSP, build config, or dependencies.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_dev_config_table_semantics.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_dev_config_table_semantics.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-203 is integrated on main with reviewed WO-195/196. This is in the final page wave. CP-42/#170 is superseded; owner will close #170 when creating the replacement issue.

## Notes and decisions
Treat this as a reference page. If an existing claim cannot be verified from the checked-in schema, flag it for owner review.
